summary: 150053568350107_1421691913314425 admin July 22, 2026 It's an exciting time in the nuclear industry - and we'll need skilled leaders to achieve its full potential. That's why we're proud to be a program partner with the Canadian Executive Nuclear Energy Management School, hosted by the University of Saskatchewan in cooperation with the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) . As part of the program, Cameco is also hosting a tour of Cigar Lake mine. During the Leadership Panel, Cameco Senior VP & Chief Corporate Officer Rachelle Girard joined other distinguished guests in sharing insights on leading through complexity, driving innovation, and shaping the future of critical industries.
